# Asset Licenses

[ASSET_LICENSES.md](ASSET_LICENSES.md) records imported models, animations, and environment assets. [Free asset credits](../FreeAssets/ASSET_CREDITS.md) cover the selected Kenney textures and particles.

For each new source, record its URL, license, commercial-use permission, attribution requirements, redistribution limits, and intended use. Preserve bundled license files and note any missing ones. Do not assume the project's code license also covers third-party assets.
